# Default dataset

The API endpoints described in this section are convenience endpoints that provide access to Actor run's default dataset without the need to resolve the dataset ID first.

Subset of functionality described in: [Datasets](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/storage-datasets.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-get.md)

## [Update default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-put.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-put.md)

## [Delete default dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-delete.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-delete.md)

## [Get default dataset items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-items-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset/items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-items-get.md)

## [Store items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-items-post.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset/items](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-items-post.md)

## [Get default dataset statistics](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-statistics-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset/statistics](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-dataset-statistics-get.md)
